identificationModule.briefTitle: Extension Study of Idelalisib in Participants With Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) Who Participated in GS-US-312-0116 (NCT01539512)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Double-Blind Extension Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Two Different Dose Levels of Single-Agent Idelalisib (GS-1101) for Previously Treated Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia A Companion Trial to Study GS-US-312-0116: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study Evaluating the Efficacy and Safety of Idelalisib (GS-1101) in Combination With Rituximab for Previously Treated Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia

armGroups.label: High-dose Idelalisib
armGroups.description: Participants will receive idelalisib 300 mg twice daily (600 mg per day).

armGroups.label: Standard-dose Idelalisib
armGroups.description: Participants will receive idelalisib 150 mg twice daily (300 mg per day)

interventions.name: Idelalisib
interventions.description: Idelalisib tablet(s) administered orally twice daily
